overview_description.description: Masdar develops and operates renewable energy projects and green hydrogen initiatives across more than 40 countries. Its portfolio includes utility-scale solar, wind, geothermal, waste-to-energy, and battery storage systems. The company aims to expand its renewable energy capacity to 100 gigawatts and produce one million metric tons of green hydrogen annually by 2030. Masdar is jointly owned by the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC), Mubadala Investment Company, and Abu Dhabi National Energy Company (TAQA). It has raised capital through green bond issuances to fund its renewable energy projects.
